label: Mob Farmer
tooltip: Which enemies to farm and how pulls work.

should_handle_targeting.label: Auto-target enemies
should_handle_targeting.tooltip: During the pull, BOCCHI picks targets. Once fighting with combat AI on, targeting is left to the AI.

force_target_central_enemy.label: Prefer the middle of the pack
force_target_central_enemy.tooltip: Without combat AI, target the enemy nearest the pack center instead of the closest one. Needs Auto-target enemies.

consider_special_mobs.label: Include special enemies
consider_special_mobs.tooltip: Also pull special enemies that only appear in certain weather or times of day.

count_special_mobs_toward_minimum.label: Count specials toward minimums
count_special_mobs_toward_minimum.tooltip:
On: specials count toward the start / fight minimums below.
Off: specials can still be pulled, but they do not count toward the start / fight minimums below.

spots.label: Farm spots
spots.tooltip: Named farm points. Start uses the highest-priority enabled spot (nearest on a tie). Empty list = start where you stand. Optional stack/stop is for caves and SW Tower.
spots.empty: No spots — Start uses where you are standing.
spots.name: Name

claimed_spot_seconds.label: Leave if claimed after (seconds)
claimed_spot_seconds.tooltip: If other players keep this pack or stand on the stack point this long, mark the spot claimed for this session and go to the next one.

claimed_player_radius.label: Claimed player radius (yalms)
claimed_player_radius.tooltip: Treat the spot as claimed if another player stays this close to the farm point or stack point.

min_euclidean_distance_to_return_home.label: Go home if farther than
min_euclidean_distance_to_return_home.tooltip: After a fight, walk back to the farm point only if farther than this (yalms).

return_to_start_in_waiting_phase.label: Return to spot after combat
return_to_start_in_waiting_phase.tooltip: Walk back to the current farm point when the fight ends. No spots: where you stood when you pressed Start.

render_debug_lines.label: Show debug lines
render_debug_lines.tooltip: While farming: red lines to valid enemies out of combat, green while fighting.

apply_battle_bell.label: Use Battle Bell
apply_battle_bell.tooltip: Before each pull: Geomancer, recast Battle Bell, then Sprint and switch back.

apply_ringing_respite.label: Use Ringing Respite
apply_ringing_respite.tooltip: With Battle Bell (or alone): Geomancer III heals you when hit. Needs Geomancer III. Waits briefly if Quickstep just used the shared cooldown.

apply_quickstep.label: Use Quickstep
apply_quickstep.tooltip: Before each pull: Phantom Dancer Quickstep (90s evasion). Needs Dancer 2. Shares a short cooldown with Ringing Respite.

apply_counterstance.label: Use Counterstance
apply_counterstance.tooltip: Near the end of pull buffs: Phantom Monk Counterstance for Fleetfooted. Needs Monk 3. Applied late so it covers the start of the pull.

maximum_battle_bell_wait_time.label: Max wait for Bell / Respite / Stance
maximum_battle_bell_wait_time.tooltip: Skip Battle Bell, Ringing Respite, or Counterstance for this pull if their cooldown is longer than this (seconds).

quickstep_skip_if_remaining_minutes.label: Skip Quickstep if remaining (minutes)
quickstep_skip_if_remaining_minutes.tooltip: Skip Quickstep when crystal Quicker Step still has at least this many minutes left. 0 = recast every pull.

minimum_mobs_to_start_fight.label: Minimum enemies before fighting
minimum_mobs_to_start_fight.tooltip: How many to gather before fighting. A spot can override this.

stacking_timeout_seconds.label: Gather timeout (seconds)
stacking_timeout_seconds.tooltip: Max time gathering before fighting starts anyway.

use_ranged_pull.label: Ranged pull (tanks)
use_ranged_pull.tooltip: While gathering, tanks use Shield Lob / Tomahawk / Unmend / Lightning Shot instead of walking into melee.

yield_to_pots.label: Stop for Magic Pots
yield_to_pots.tooltip:
On: pause for a live or soon-to-spawn Magic Pot (and pot chests if that General option is on). Timing under Pot timing.
Off: keep farming through pots.
Resumes after the pot.

cast_treasure_sight_at_farm.label: Cast Treasure Sight at the farm spot
cast_treasure_sight_at_farm.tooltip:
On: cast Sight at your farm spot on the interval below, then resume pulling — no Treasure Hunt run.
Needs Freelancer 10+. Works with no Spots list (Start uses where you are standing).
Off: only the full Treasure Hunt yield below can refresh counts.

yield_to_treasure_hunt.label: Treasure Hunt on a timer
yield_to_treasure_hunt.tooltip:
On: pause and run Treasure Hunt on the interval below if remaining bronze/silver meets the % on Treasure Hunter.
Needs a recent Treasure Sight reading.
Off: no timed Treasure Hunt from Mob Farmer.

treasure_hunt_prefer_pots.label: Prioritize pots during timed hunt
treasure_hunt_prefer_pots.tooltip:
On: the timed hunt runs as Pots & Treasure, so a Magic Pot (and pot chests if that General option is on) still interrupts the route.
Off: plain Treasure Hunt only — use Stop for Magic Pots above to leave while farming, not mid-hunt.
Needs Treasure Hunt on a timer.

yield_to_crystal_buffs.label: Refresh crystal buffs when low
yield_to_crystal_buffs.tooltip:
On: pause to reapply knowledge-crystal buffs at or below the reapply time on the Buffs page.
Off: keep farming without buff pauses.
Needs Automate buffs on the Buffs page.
